images.caption: This is a picture of a footbridge at Gooch-Dillard Residence Hall. The footbridge extends from the bottom middle to the middle of the photograph. It extends over a ditch. It is wooden with some metal treads perpendicular to its railings, which are gray metal. It is slightly curved such that the middle is higher than the sides. It leads to a walkway that splits: one direction goes to the right, while the other goes to the left, towards the brick residence building. The second branch is behind a coniferous tree. Save for this tree, all the other trees in the wooded area where this photograph was taken are bare. The ground is dirt, with some forest detritus. The sky is a vibrant blue with a single cloud visible over the residence building.

images.caption: This is a picture of Dillard Residence Hall at the University of Virginia. In the foreground of the picture, there is a wooded area on a hill. Most of the trees are bare, save for a few coniferous trees to the left and some bushes in the immediate foreground. The ground is dirt with some forest detritus. A white concrete sidewalk extends from the bottom left to the middle of the photograph and goes up the hill. A black tall lamppost is to its left. At the top of the hill is the brick structure of Dillard residence hall, which is divided into two sections. One section faces is on the left and towards the right and is behind the lamppost. The other is perpendicular to the first and faces the observer. The two are connected by a roof covering a walkway. Gooch residence hall is on the far right of the photograph. Behind the first section is a small structure. The sky is a vibrant blue, with a cloud visible right behind the second section of Dillard.

images.caption: This is a picture of Gooch Residence Hall at the University of Virginia. In the foreground of the picture, there is a wooded area on a hill with a dirt ground and some forest detritus, divided by a white concrete sidewalk that extends from the bottom left to the middle of the photograph and goes up the hill. To the left of the sidewalk are trees, most of which are bare, save for a coniferous tree near the crest of the hill. A black tall lamppost is to the right of the sidewalk. The sidewalk reaches its visible end at the crest of the hill, where there is a flat area, then another hill. At the top of this hill is the brick structure of Gooch residence hall, which is divided into two sections. One section is to the right and faces towards the left .The other is perpendicular to the first and faces the observer. The second is tiered/staggered in such a way that the lower part is on the right and the higher part is on the right; it follows the contours of the second hill. Dillard residence hall is on the far right of the photograph. The sky is a vibrant blue, with a cloud visible between Gooch and Dillard.
